flags.why: The expression vô duyên vô cớ is common in everyday speech, so the literary tag is misleading.
The territorial recovery sense is an old usage, as marked in [Rung's dictionary](https://v2.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Thu_ph%E1%BB%A5c).
Chấn chỉnh belongs to formal corrective or administrative language rather than neutral casual speech.
This organisational sense also belongs to formal administrative language.
This word belongs mainly to formal analytical or scientific language, as noted in [VDict](https://vdict.com/t%C6%B0%C6%A1ng%20quan%2C3%2C0%2C0.html).
Chuốt describes smoothing or refining, not applying a ceramic glaze; [Rung's definition](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Chu%E1%BB%91t) specifies smoothing with a sharp blade.
flags.fix: to smooth by shaving or scraping

flags.why: Bảng hiệu is mainly Southern usage, while Northern speakers generally use biển hiệu, consistent with the regional distinction described [here](https://www.toiyeutiengnuoctoi.com/ban-bang-hay-bien/).
